label: Every actual distinct esse descends via actual causes of being from one whose esse is its essence
paraphrase: For every x in act whose represented esse differs from its essence (DistinctEsseAt), there is some n in act as to being, whose represented esse equals its essence, from which x's esse descends through a finite chain of actual causes of being (Relation.TransGen of ActualEsseCause; mode of causing unspecified, tenseless). n heads that chain; it is not said to be uncaused. It is De ente c.3 [69874]'s reduction of what has esse from another to what does not, restricted to esse and read with 'what does not have esse from another' as a being whose esse is its essence. Not asserted: that n is uncaused, causes x's esse directly, conserves it now, is the only such n, exists necessarily, is concrete at a world, or is God.
